dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline curvature from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is characterized by a small pixel radius, morphologically rounded-acute.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Low-gradient anterior margin slope with a shallow angle relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High horizontal-to-vertical ratio, with the base length significantly exceeding the vertical apex height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous white punctate surface lesions and a distinct jagged notch at the posterior base of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The fin is integrated into an elongated, low-profile dorsal hump extending anteriorly across the visible frame.
